results.prompt_sent:
Take the seed input: FIFA Men’s World Cup edition 2022.

Which footballers were named to a national team squad for the seed World Cup edition, AND have EVER won the best player award of a domestic league in which they played club football at any point in their career — before, during, or after that edition, in any season, and in any country in which they played?

A league's best player award means the season-long award presented to the best player of that league, whether it is given by the league itself, by the players' union or by the press. Monthly or weekly awards, young-player, goalkeeper, top-scorer and team-of-the-season honours, cup awards, and continental or international awards do not count.

The set of leagues is not given to you and it differs for every player. For each squad player you must work out for yourself which domestic league(s) he played in during his career, which best player award each of those leagues has (or had), and whether he won it. Decide for yourself what "domestic league" means. Do not restrict yourself to a short list of well-known leagues or awards: leagues in any country count, and so do awards under any name, including awards of leagues that have been renamed or no longer exist.

For each such player, give: each qualifying award, their birthplace, and the population of that birthplace. For birthplace, give the actual place of birth (a city, town, or settlement) — not a country, a historical polity, or a sports club/national-team entity.

Return the complete set of qualifying players for this edition, not just examples. If no player qualifies, state that explicitly rather than omitting the edition.

Output format, one row per qualifying player:

S.No	WorldCup_Year	TargetPlayer	Award_Type	Birthplace	Population

In the Award_Type cell write every qualifying award as 'Award name (League, Country, Season)', separated by '; ' when the player has several.

After the table, add one line beginning 'INTERPRETATION:' that states in one or two sentences what you took 'domestic league' to mean and how you decided which leagues were relevant for each player.

RESPONSE MUST CONTAIN — citation of the source used for confirming the seed FIFA World Cup edition was actually held (and not cancelled or abandoned) in the stated calendar year, the source(s) used for the list of players named to national team squads for that edition, the source(s) used to establish which domestic league(s) each qualifying player played in, the source(s) used to establish that he won each listed league's best player award, the source for each qualifying player's birthplace, and the source for the population of that birthplace. 

RESPONSE MUST ALSO CONTAIN - citations in the same order in which it is used to answer the query clearly stating the steps and citations against it.
